activities.text:
🫁 Sucking wind! You skipped 𝐁𝐖𝐑𝐀𝐅 and at 15 m the regulator feels like a clamped straw.

Unpack the 𝐧𝐞𝐠𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐜𝐤-𝐨𝐧 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐞𝐪𝐮𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐬 of skipping a pre-dive safety check.
activities.answer:
• Restricted airflow forces you to 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤 𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐞𝐫 → CO₂ rises → panic onset
• Panic at depth → 𝐫𝐚𝐩𝐢𝐝 𝐮𝐧𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐬𝐜𝐞𝐧𝐭 → DCS or lung overexpansion
• Trust erosion in the 𝐛𝐮𝐝𝐝𝐲 𝐭𝐞𝐚𝐦
activities.assessment_notes:
𝐆𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐆𝐮𝐢𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞
• Accept any 3+ valid knock-on consequences
• Reward chain-of-consequence thinking
• Mark down responses that suggest "ascend slowly to fix it"

𝐄𝐱𝐭𝐫𝐚 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐱𝐭
• BWRAF = PADI 5-point pre-dive safety check (BCD, Weights, Releases, Air, Final OK).
• Knock-on means second/third-order effects, not the immediate sensation.
outcomes: Sample pre-seeded outcome with emoji 🎯 and bold 𝐭𝐞𝐱𝐭

activities.text:
⚡ Quick recall. Type out what each letter of 𝐁𝐖𝐑𝐀𝐅 stands for:

𝐁 = ?
𝐖 = ?
𝐑 = ?
𝐀 = ?
𝐅 = ?
activities.answer:
• 𝐁 = BCD
• 𝐖 = Weights
• 𝐑 = Releases
• 𝐀 = Air
• 𝐅 = Final OK
activities.assessment_notes:
𝐆𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐆𝐮𝐢𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞
• Must get all 5 letters
• Accept variants ("BCD"/"Buoyancy", "Final OK"/"OK ready")
• Order matters: B → W → R → A → F
